{{Quote|This is Vynock Leader. Target destroyed.|Vynock Leader|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Vynock Leader''' was the callsign of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the leader of the [[Vynock Squadron]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] the squadron participated in the attack on the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Aegis Base]], during which [[Vynock Six]] was shot down, but Vynock Leader and his squadron had successfully accomplished the mission objective.
